allowed_ref_prefixes.rationale: primary artifact tree (tasks, plans, decisions, verify, status, governance, scripts, registry, metrics, code, test, research, improvement)
git HEAD reference at task close
git commit shorthand prefix used in narrative refs
inline key=value tokens used by verify artifact (e.g., 'HEAD at task start: <sha>')

ref_format_rules.markdown_link_unwrap_required_before_mat: if line starts with '[' and contains '(' then extract inside ](...)
ref_format_rules.inline_trailing_label_stripping_required: if line contains ' ' and not startswith('HEAD') and not contains('://') then split on first space and keep prefix
ref_format_rules.trailing_anchor_handling: anchor (#section-name) allowed after path; anchor portion not validated against disk
ref_format_rules.trailing_query_handling: query (?key=value) not allowed; treated as malformed
ref_format_rules.duplicate_ref_handling: permitted; not deduplicated by parser; downstream may dedupe

local_artifact_constraints.current_pcacc_002_malformed_branch: if '://' in ref or ref.startswith('/') or (len(ref) >= 2 and ref[1] == ':') then malformed (unless HEAD or scheme prefix override applies)

required_ref_contexts.description: verify artifact ## Build Guarantee or ## Acceptance Criteria Checklist asserts a blocking outcome (pass/fail)
verify artifact references a JSON evidence file under artifacts/verify/<task>/
verify artifact references a negative-test result JSON (e.g., pcacc-negative-test-result.json, qc-sync-negative-test-result.json)
status artifact's verify_artifact_ref or evidence_paths must point at existing repo-relative paths
decision artifact ## Guard Exception with Exception Type=allow-scope-drift cites Scope Files; verify artifact must echo references to those waivered files

optional_ref_contexts.description: lifecycle setup or scope-freeze tasks where verify cites only governance plan / manifest documents
optional_ref_contexts.allowed_when: task scope_class in {scope_freeze, design_decision_only, design_only_policy_registry_prototype} and Build Guarantee declares None for non-applicable build units

optional_ref_contexts.description: verify artifact describes follow-up candidate tasks that have no lifecycle artifact yet
optional_ref_contexts.allowed_when: candidate task ID is not yet allocated and is documented as advisory (e.g., follow-up candidates listed in design artifact §12)

optional_ref_contexts.description: verify artifact records a deferred or unverifiable AC item with explicit decision_ref
optional_ref_contexts.allowed_when: AC item result in {deferred, unverifiable} and decision_ref or reason_code is recorded

optional_ref_contexts.description: verify artifact surfaces advisory-only metric or sanity check that does not gate pass/fail
optional_ref_contexts.allowed_when: AC item is marked advisory and not in blocking gate set

malformed_ref_behavior.exit_code_mapping_if_runtime_consumed: exit_code=1 when violations present, exit_code=2 when registry load itself fails

missing_ref_behavior.current_pcacc_002_missing_branch: ref starts with allowed local prefix but target not is_file() and not is_dir() -> missing

pcacc_compatibility.backward_compatibility_clause: any future runtime registry-driven PCACC-002 must produce identical reason_code strings and identical pass/fail outcomes for the existing TASK-1030 fixtures and any future fixture added under PCACC-002 strict scope; no silent fallback to in-module default; runtime registry load failure maps to exit code 2 (hard guard error), not 0 or 1

future_extraction_acceptance_criteria.description: production runner reads the registry only under an explicitly authorized future task lifecycle (separate from TASK-1033)
future_extraction_acceptance_criteria.evidence_required: future task plan references this prototype path and explicitly toggles runtime_consumption_authorized=true under that task's decision artifact

future_extraction_acceptance_criteria.description: default behavior remains backward compatible with current PCACC-002 (TASK-1030 NEG-002 / NEG-003 must still pass)
future_extraction_acceptance_criteria.evidence_required: future task verify artifact reruns TASK-1030 negative test fixtures or equivalents and records identical reason_codes

future_extraction_acceptance_criteria.description: no new active PCACC check is added under this prototype
future_extraction_acceptance_criteria.evidence_required: future task plan does not introduce PCACC-005 or any active check beyond PCACC-001..PCACC-004

future_extraction_acceptance_criteria.description: registry schema validation occurs at runner load time and is fail-closed
future_extraction_acceptance_criteria.evidence_required: future task adds schema validation step that rejects unknown fields, missing required fields, malformed prefix list, or non-string enum entries; exit code 2 on validation failure

future_extraction_acceptance_criteria.description: source/template sync policy for this registry path is explicitly defined before consumption
future_extraction_acceptance_criteria.evidence_required: if registry resides under artifacts/scripts/ then EXACT_SYNC_FILES extension is governed via separate decision artifact and template mirror is created byte_identical; if registry resides under artifacts/governance/prototypes/ or artifacts/governance/ then unpaired path is documented and no mirror obligation applies

future_extraction_acceptance_criteria.description: rollback path exists and is documented
future_extraction_acceptance_criteria.evidence_required: future task plan documents revert procedure: registry file removal, runner code revert, sha256 restoration of run_precommit_check.py, and rerun of TASK-1030 fixtures

future_extraction_acceptance_criteria.description: Codex post-commit verification passes for the future runtime extraction task
future_extraction_acceptance_criteria.evidence_required: Codex post-commit verification reports PASS on the future task's verify artifact and on TASK-1030 NEG-002 / NEG-003 fixture rerun

future_extraction_acceptance_criteria.description: QC-SYNC-001 negative test exists for the registry path if paired
future_extraction_acceptance_criteria.evidence_required: if paired path is chosen, a future task adds a negative test inheriting TASK-1029 model (NEG-001/002/003 patterns) for the registry mirror, with passing result

future_extraction_acceptance_criteria.description: no v3.5.x lifecycle artifact (TASK-1023..TASK-1033) is retroactively modified by the future runtime extraction task
future_extraction_acceptance_criteria.evidence_required: future task verify artifact records sha256 of v3.5.x lifecycle artifacts unchanged

limitations: TASK-1033 is design-only; this prototype does not authorize any runtime consumption.

The prototype mirrors the current PCACC-002 implementation in artifacts/scripts/run_precommit_check.py at sha256=5d1fcd1f96948028... and is bound to that runner's behavior; later runner edits invalidate this prototype until re-validated.

allowed_ref_prefixes is conservative and only covers prefixes already accepted by PCACC-002 today; expansion (e.g., HTTP URL schemes) would require a separate decision artifact and is not authorized here.
Required versus optional context taxonomy is design-level; runtime mapping of task scope_class to ORC-1..ORC-4 is deferred to a future runtime extraction task.
Reason codes listed under malformed_ref_behavior and missing_ref_behavior reflect the current PCACC-002 strings; runtime adoption must preserve string identity to keep TASK-1030 negative tests green.
future_extraction_acceptance_criteria FE-1..FE-9 are forward-looking constraints; this prototype does not create the future task lifecycle and does not promise FE-* satisfaction.
Source policy refs include the v3.5.1 governance design artifact and decision matrix as inputs; this prototype does not modify those artifacts.
non_authorization is explicit and load-bearing; any reading of this prototype as implicit authorization is incorrect.

This prototype lives under artifacts/governance/prototypes/ specifically to keep it out of the current PCACC-002 runner's load path; it must not be moved into artifacts/governance/ without a separate decision artifact governing the move.

Schema validation of this prototype itself is performed only by the read-only inspection helper artifacts/verify/TASK-1033/inspect_evidence_ref_policy_prototype.py and the inspection evidence JSON; no production validator consumes it.
